Hidden gem worth finding for a delightful, authentic meal.
Mar 2026 • Couples
Based on the great reviews we gave this little spot a try for lunch and so glad that we did! I’m vegan and my husband is not but we both enjoyed the dishes that we shared - traditional and mushroom dumplings, vermicelli noodles w veggies and tofu and crispy rice balls w peanuts. Everything was flavourful, fresh and made with care. The service was friendly, everything was clean and really appreciated that the back of the menu had an Appendix listing the ingredients of each dish. I haven’t seen this before and thought it was a great idea. Highly recommend this spot for a very reasonably priced, satisfying and authentic meal.

Good food in an open restaurant. Very friendly staff. Located in a non-touristy area.
Dec 2023 • Family
Restaurant itself was good. Small with very friendly staff. However, it is located in a seemingly very local area and we made the mistake of walking there at dinnertime. We were bombarded by hundreds of motorcycles with virtually no sidewalk, so we were dodging cars and motorcycles nonstop, which was very stressful. I do recommend the restaurant if you want something different and light from the regular Vietnamese fare, but do not walk there! Take a Grab or a taxi.
